extra_flags: --allowedTools=Bash(shasum:*),Bash(wc:*),Bash(ls:*),Bash(plutil -lint*),Bash(python3:*),Bash(git show:*),Bash(git diff:*),Bash(git log:*),Bash(git status:*),Bash(printf:*),Bash(test:*),Bash(pwd:*),Bash(cd:*),Bash(echo:*),Bash(date -u:*),Bash(printenv JOB_SCRATCH),Bash(printenv KY_SCRATCH),Bash(printenv KY_FLEET),Bash(printenv TMPDIR),Bash(git rev-parse:*),Bash(git ls-files:*)
_note: Verifier retains all denied tools/commands. Bash permits named job-path checks (printenv only JOB_SCRATCH/KY_SCRATCH/KY_FLEET/TMPDIR), read-only Git checks and python3 packet tests. Launcher adds only JOB_SCRATCH for tool access and derives CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR=JOB_SCRATCH/tmp; TMPDIR alone does not redirect Bash temp files. Authentication keeps its existing namespace. Every qualification canary uses the live Seatbelt profile, source-view layout, job-folder access and temp override, including a measured job-folder write. Requalify after installation or template/card/binary/harness changes.
